newsitem.title: USA: Midcoast Energy sees Q3 $0.22-$0.24 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Midcoast Energy sees Q3 $0.22-$0.24 EPS.

text.p: Midcoast Energy Resources Inc expects to post net income of about $475,000 to $500,000, or $0.22 to $0.24 a share for the third quarter and about $1 million, or about $0.55 to $0.60 a share for the nine months ended September 30, President Dan Tutcher said Wednesday.

The natural gas pipeline company expects to report revenue of about $5 million for the third quarter and $15 million for the nine months, about double revenues in the same period last year, Tutcher said in an interview with Reuters.
"The biggest thing is that the acquisitions we have made in the third quarter will have a full quarter's effect in the fourth quarter and going forward," he said.

The growth has been fueled by acquisitions that increased the Houston company's natural gas pipeline system to about 600 miles from 360 miles and added a net 20 million cubic feet (mmcfd) of natural gas a day to a pipeline system that now handles about about 90 mmcfd, Tutcher said.
Midcoast Energy shares began trading on the American Stock Exchange on August 9 following a one million share offering that netted $8.8 million to the company.
